'''Danoor System Control''' served as the planetary traffic control for the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Danoor]]. All [[Starship/Legends|ships]] entering the [[Nah'Malis system]] with intentions to land on the planet had to be cleared through Danoor System Control.
